summary.en: Ancient lake and river delta; Perseverance landing site and sample cache
summary.tr: Eski göl ve nehir deltası; Perseverance iniş yeri ve numune deposu

elevation.rationale: Approximate; replace with a MOLA MEGDR sample (raster adapter)

ice.rationale: 18° N: near-surface ice is not expected this close to the equator (ez2015, piqueux2019); water would come from hydrated minerals

dust.rationale: No site-specific dust climatology imported: global annual mean τ ≈ 0.5 assumed at every site, so this criterion does not separate the sites until data are imported

science.rationale: Delta and lake sediments with organics potential; Perseverance cached samples; MEDA weather record

beam exp(−τ/μ) + assumed diffuse term, τ = 0.50 (assumption)

transforms: radiative balance T = ((1 − A)·Ī / (ε σ))^¼ with A = 0.25, ε = 0.95 (assumed)
Ī = 131.0 W/m² from the insolation model
temperature.note: Annual mean surface temperature; no atmosphere greenhouse, no thermal inertia (±15 K)

transforms: p = 636 Pa · exp(−h / 11.1 km), h = -2600 m (assumption)
pressure.note: Annual mean; seasonal swing about ±25 % (Fact Sheet 4.0–8.7 mb)

transforms: column mass = p / g, g = 3.73 m/s²
column.note: Atmosphere above the site: more mass = more braking for landing and more shielding (indicator, not a dose)

transforms: stereo heights from photo pairs, σZ = (H/B)·GSD·σpx = 13.7 mm
slope over 2 m ≤ 10° and no rock ≥ 0.5 m (rocks seen when ≥ 3 px)
uncertainty: sampling 2.8 % ⊕ threshold 6.9 %
